sentences.text: Heard on I.A. No.7032/2022 which is first application for suspension of jail sentence filed on behalf of appellants - Ramprasad and Raju.

Vide judgment dated 18.12.2019 passed by the 23rd Additional Sessions Judge, Bhopal in Special Case No.516/18 appellants have been convicted for the offence under Sections 376(2), 323, 506 of IPC and under Section 5/6 of POCSO Act and sentenced to undergo Life Imprisonment with fine Rs.2000/-, and 03 years R.I. with fine of Rs.500/- respectively, with usual default stipulation.
As per the prosecution story, PW-2 lodged a report that her husband died in the year 2017 and thereafter, she started living with Ramprasad along with her 05 children.
Ramprasad used to beat her and therefore, she started living separately.
She and her daughter used to visit the house of Ramprasad to do the household chores.
Ramprasad and the co-accused have committed sexual assault with PW-1 and accordingly, an FIR was lodged.
Learned counsel for the appellants submitted that the appellants have falsely been implicated in the case and they are real brothers.
The story is concocted.
The age of the prosecutrix has not been proved by cogent 2 CRA-638-2020 evidence.
If there was a previous occurrence then there was no occasion for the mother to send her daughter to the house of the appellant.
There is no DNA report which is mandatory in case of allegations of rape specially with a minor.

At the time of arrest, the appellants Ramprasad and Raju aged about 58 years and 62 respectively and they are in jail since the date of arrest and they have completed almost seven years of jail sentence and are now nearing to 70 years of age.
The appeal is not likely to be heard in near future, hence he prays for grant of bail and suspension of remaining jail sentence of the appellants till the final disposal of this appeal.

sentences.text: Per contra, learned GA for the respondent/State opposes the application for suspension of sentence and prays for its rejection.

Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for both the parties, nature and gravity of the allegation against the appellants and also taking note of the fact that appellants is in custody since last 07 years, this appeal is of the year 2020 and it is not likely to be heard in near future, we deem it proper to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant.

Accordingly, IA No.7032/2022 is allowed and the execution of remaining jail sentence of the appellants - Ramprasad and Raju is hereby suspended till the final disposal of this appeal and it is ordered that the appellants be released on bail on their depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, and upon furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand) each with one solvent surety of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the trial Court, with a further direction to 3 CRA-638-2020 appear before the Registry of this Court on 21.1.2025 and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry of this Court in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
C.C. as per rules.
